correctness.rationale: A geometric fixed simplex supports unions of full admissible S_k vertex orbits. Internal orbit diameter 2min(w,k−w) selects weights 0,1,k−1,k. Exact maximum distances give two families of principal clique complexes, each collapsing by dominated-vertex U_z→A_z or V_z→B_z onto X_f. For k≥5 no cross edges and two disjoint copies of X_f remain. For k=4 precisely 2·2^f cross edges are maximal 1-cells; since both principal complexes connected, attaching them produces 2^{f+1}−1 independent circles together with the two copies. Independently reconstructed orbit graph adjacency in bounded k,f cases from all binary representatives; explicit combinatorial proof covers all k,f.
